class.name: IfcFastener
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Representations of fixing parts which are used as fasteners to connect or join elements with other elements. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x2 IFC 2x4 change: Attribute PredefinedType added.

members.member: Subtype of fastener A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
